{{Short description|Russian geophysicist and educator (1932–2019)}}
{{Orphan|date=January 2019}}

'''Tatiana B. Yanovskaya''' (11 August 1932 - 22 December 2019) was a Russian [[geophysicist]] and educator.<ref>{{cite web |title=Tatiana B. Yanovskaya (1932 – 2019) |url=http://iaspei.org/about/bios-obituaries/tatiana-yanovskaya-1932-2019 |website=iaspei.org/ |access-date=14 January 2021}}</ref>

She studied physics at Leningrad State University (later [[Saint Petersburg State University]]) and completed a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] at the Institute of Physics of the Earth in [[Moscow]] in 1958. From 1958 to 1960, she worked at the Pulkova seismological station. From 1960 to 1968, Yanovskaya was a junior researcher at the Leningrad division of the [[Steklov Institute of Mathematics|Mathematical Institute]] of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]]. In 1968, she began working at the Department of Geophysics at Leningrad State University. In 1986, she became a full professor at Saint Petersburg State University.<ref name=egu/>

Her areas of research include computer modelling of the propagation of surface waves and of [[tsunami]]s and determining variations in cross-sections of the Earth's crust and [[upper mantle (Earth)|upper mantle]] based on seismic data.<ref name=egu/>

She served on the editorial boards for the Russian journal ''Izvestiya, Physics of the Solid Earth'' and for the ''Chinese Journal of Geophysics''. She was a lecturer for a series of workshops for young seismologists held by the [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]].<ref name=egu/>

In 1982, along with three colleagues, she received the USSR State Prize for Science and Technique. In 1997, she was named a fellow of the [[American Geophysical Union]]. In 2002, she was awarded the {{ill|Beno Gutenberg Medal|de}}.<ref name=egu>{{cite web |url=https://www.egu.eu/awards-medals/beno-gutenberg/2002/tatiana-b-yanovskaya/ |title=Tatiana B. Yanovskaya |publisher=European Geosciences Union}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |url=https://physicstoday.scitation.org/doi/abs/10.1063/1.2409342?journalCode=pto |title=Scientists Recognized for Geophysical Work |journal=Physics Today |volume=55 |issue=7 |page=72 |date=July 2002 |doi=10.1063/1.2409342|bibcode=2002PhT....55R..72. |url-access=subscription }}</ref>
